verdict: PASS: main-release and long256-release are bit-exact on all 20 cases vs the EXISTING teacher-bf128 reference (125/125 logit comparisons 0.0, 20/20 NLL lists identical, PPL delta 0.0)

mechanism.chosen: (b) restart the experiment unit with the SAME profile right before long-120000, inside quality.py --teacher
mechanism.how: quality.teacher(): cases 1-19 on the server qualify.py started; before each CLEAN_CACHE_CASES case (only 'long-120000', the last case) stop + start-experiment.sh <same profile> + check-experiment.py 300 (the exact qualify.start sequence, via matrix.run); the new active-run.json must differ only in run_id/started_utc. Then binding checks: the last teacher.jsonl row per (profile, case) - exactly what compare-quality.py selects - must be this run's row for all 20 cases, and the clean run must hold only long-120000 (i.e. it was the fresh server's first request).
mechanism.report: teacher report keeps 'run' = full receipt of the first run (19 cases; final-helpers extract-run unchanged); adds 'clean_cache' {harness v7, mode restart_same_profile, cases, runs:[full receipt of the restart]}; rows gain 'run_id' and 'clean_cache'.
mechanism.why_not_engine_endpoint: FreeToken already has POST /v1/cache/rebuild (api_server.py -> Scheduler.rebuild_cache -> CacheManager.rebuild, idle-only), but guard.py/ingress.py ALLOWED blocks it (404). Using it means changing the production guard/ingress (service identity, security surface) plus proving a same-size rebuild (pool realloc + CUDA-graph recapture) numerically neutral. The restart touches 1 harness file, no engine/service/allowlist change, and is the exact state the GPU-proven run C used.
mechanism.why_not_other: filler request to force eviction: the filler would itself share the 3-token chat-template header (still a dedup); reordering cases: every other case would then dedup against long-120000's KV and invalidate the reference.
mechanism.numerics_effect_otherwise: none: same requests, order, seeds, engine and profile; only the server process is fresh for the last case
